content.text:
In Seattle, **5,154** permit applications are currently in plan review.

That's every Seattle record whose status counts as "in review." Applications still at intake (19) and permits that are issued (7,835), finaled, expired or cancelled aren't counted. Withdrawn, denied and closed-without-a-permit applications fall under "cancelled," so they're left out too.

I didn't filter by application date, because 510 of these records don't have one. Counting only the records that do have an application date gives 4,644. Some of the 510 are exception and exemption requests that have been waiting on corrections for a long time. The data covers building and land-use records only. Seattle publishes electrical, mechanical and plumbing permits in a separate dataset that this count doesn't include.

FINAL ANSWER: 5154
